materialChanges: Long-session turn navigation can preview and jump to unloaded paginated turns.
Long-conversation memory use and syntax highlighting responsiveness were improved.
Queued and steered images are echoed and delivered reliably; continuable-subagent follow-ups support images.
read_image detects extensionless image attachment paths by content.
Tab completes the highlighted slash command.
Connection handling tolerates stalled hosts without falsely reporting disconnects.
Schedule catalog layout was fixed for narrow viewports.
Optional SQLite session persistence was removed; JSONL remains the session persistence path.

pluginBoundaryAnalysis.observedCompatibility: All existing Relay registrations, packed assets, composition, browser loading, and covered feature probes passed on alpha.3.
pluginBoundaryAnalysis.sqliteImpact: No Relay plugin depends on the removed DSH SQLite session-persistence package. relay-dsh-plugin-events uses its own node:sqlite database and is unaffected.
